sections.Description:
Players will immerse themselves in an interactive Iron Maiden universe transforming into various forms of Eddie, the band’s legendary mascot.

Players, as Eddie, will embark on a quest to defeat the Beast and his minions across the Legacy of the Beast mobile game and comic book world. Iron Maiden pinball entertains with an amazing array of modern and classic features, making it suitable for all skill levels.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Shoot the Underworld Scoop: Start 6 modes by shooting the Laser-cut stainless steel center ramp, or underneath the the actuating ramp on the Premium and LE.
- Sarcophagus: Motorized Sarcophagus ball lock mechanism with industry first, hit-detecting Newton ball.
- 3 Target Bank: Featuring a 3 Target Bank at the center of the playfield featuring all hand drawn art by Zombie Yeti.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- Twelve selectable Iron Maiden hit songs featuring: Ace’s High, Number of the Beast, and more.
- Laser-cut stainless steel center ‘jump’ ramp.
- Pro Model exclusive themed full color art by Zombie Yeti.

Premium:
- Powder coasted wrinkle steel bottom arch.
- Laser-cut stainless steel center ‘jump’ ramp.
- Stacked backlit Egyptian temple plastics on back panel.

Limited Edition:
- High powered speaker system with 3 channel amplifier.
- LE model exclusive art blades with high definition brushed foil decal battlefield themed cabinet art.
- Powder-coated metallic red side armor, hinges and front lockdown molding.
